hero.sub1: Web developer in the making. Graphic designer by instinct.
hero.sub2: Security curious. Based in the Philippines.

about.label: 01 — About
about.p1: I'm Marlloyd, you can call me Lloydie, a web developer and graphic designer with a passion for clean, purposeful work. I build web interfaces with modern tools and design visual assets that communicate effectively — blending technical and creative thinking.
about.p2: Currently expanding into ethical hacking and security concepts, because understanding how things break is part of building them right.

projects.label: 03 — Projects
projects.heading: Selected Work
projects.farmcopal_desc: A modular SaaS for cooperatives — activate loans, savings, milling, and more on demand. Built-in dynamic bookkeeping lets you assign debit & credit entries to exact accounts, keeping every transaction transparent and fully auditable.
projects.obiyen_desc: An all-in-one business suite in the spirit of Zoho — bringing CRM, operations, and everyday productivity tools together in one connected platform, with a Nuxt web app and a React Native mobile client backed by Laravel.
projects.citizenone_desc: A SaaS platform built for the healthcare industry — streamlining patient and provider workflows into one secure, connected system across web (Nuxt) and mobile (React Native), powered by a Laravel backend.
projects.gearup_desc: Shop smarter for PC and electronic parts. Gear Up is a mobile e-commerce app with clean product browsing, smart discovery, and a fast checkout — built for builders, enthusiasts, and everyday shoppers alike.

journey.label: 04 — Journey
journey.heading: Road Taken
journey.intern_detail: 5-month remote engagement with a Danish company, contributing to real-world web development projects and sharpening professional skills in a global environment.
journey.intern_task1: Developed new features and resolved bugs in production web applications
journey.intern_task2: Built a dynamic form builder — lets end-users create custom forms on the fly, no developer intervention needed
journey.bsit_detail: Pursued a 4-year BSIT degree, building a strong foundation in software development, systems design, networking, and database management. Graduated 2026.
journey.itsupport_detail: 4 years of hands-on IT support starting from 1st year college — managing school systems, troubleshooting hardware and software, and keeping the institution's tech running smoothly.
journey.shs_detail: Completed Senior High School in Davao City, building academic groundwork and sharpening critical thinking before entering college.
journey.jhs_detail: Completed Junior High School in Cateel, Davao Oriental — the foundational years that sparked curiosity in technology and problem-solving.
journey.elem_detail: Where the journey began — 6 years at Maryknoll Academy in Cateel, Davao Oriental. The starting point of a long road still being written.
